verdicts.shape: Ratio 60, not a power of ten. With lot 1 corrected by x100 the lots add up exactly to the procedure figure: £600m (lot 1) + £150m (lot 2) + £250m (lot 3) = £1,000m. Lot 1 is a x100 slip.
verdicts.true_value: About £1.0bn for the procedure (lot 1 about £600m). That is roughly €1.2bn, not €72bn.
verdicts.evidence: FTS 004793-2022 (Essex CC residential/nursing care IRN refresh, 1 version). Procedure estimated_value is £1,000,000,000. Lot 1 (residential care for ECC) is £60,000,000,000, lot 2 is £150,000,000 and lot 3 is £250,000,000. Lot text says ECC's current gross cost is about £140m per annum for lots 1 and 2 together, so £60bn for lot 1 is impossible and £600m fits a multi-year framework. Issue 505 also notes the buyer's later IRN notices state £600m and £1.57bn.

verdicts.shape: Single lot. Ratio 100.9, which is x100 times 222/220. Raw lot BT-27 is '22200000000' with no decimal point, while procedure BT-27 is '220000000.00'. The lot was typed in cents and read as euros, so it means €222,000,000, about the procedure's €220m.
verdicts.true_value: At most about €220m, the procedure estimate. The buyer's real scale may be far lower: the single-bid award is €382,486.23 for a 2-year contract. Not €22.2bn in any reading.
verdicts.evidence: Hamburg prison laundry framework (eForms 00288335-2025 / award 00387248-2025), term 2025-07-01 to 2027-06-30 with 2 renewals. Raw CN has EstimatedOverallContractAmount 220000000.00 (procedure) and 22200000000 (lot). The award XML shows the same cents-as-units habit: TotalAmount, Higher and Lower TenderAmount are 382486.23, but the tender PayableAmount is 38248623. €22.2bn for prison laundry is impossible.

verdicts.shape: Ratio 534.2, not a power of ten. Lot 2's framework maximum is x1000 too high. Every lot's maximum is 1.2 x its estimate: 3.025→3.63, 7.44→8.928, so lot 2's 12.0 should give 14.4. With lot 2 at €14.4m the lot maxima sum exactly to the procedure maximum: 3.63 + 14.4 + 8.928 = €26.958m.
verdicts.true_value: Lot 2 maximum €14.4m. Procedure maximum €26,958,000 (estimate €22,465,000). Actual awards total about €14.43m: €2.42m + €7.296m + €4.712m.
verdicts.evidence: HZD Hessen DMS support (00408878-2024 CN, 00754738-2024 CAN). Raw CN lot 2 has FrameworkMaximumAmount 14400000000.00 next to EstimatedOverallContractAmount 12000000.00. The other lots are 3630000.00/3025000.00 and 8928000.00/7440000.00, and the procedure estimate is 22465000.00. Lot 2 was awarded at €7,296,000 to CGI.

verdicts.shape: Ratio 3963, not a power of ten and not a sum relation; lot 2 has no amount. Lot 1's VALUE_COST FMTVAL is 8501350000, i.e. €8.5bn for organic-waste collection in Bolzano. That is absurd and looks like a mis-keyed figure (perhaps 850,135 with extra digits).
verdicts.true_value: €2,145,000 for 36 months, as the procedure figure and the notice text both state.
verdicts.evidence: TED 044464-2011 (SEAB Bolzano, collection of organic waste plus bin washing). Raw XML has lot 1 VALUE_COST FMTVAL="8501350000" ('8 501 350 000') with quantity '294 479/per anno'. The procedure VALUE_COST is FMTVAL="2145000", and the text says 'importo complessivo presunto ... 2 145 000,00 EUR (IVA esclusa)' for 36 months including a 1-year renewal. The bid guarantee is 2% of the 2-year value.

verdicts.shape: Both lots are x1000 slips: the raw values '6686893930' and '7423090510' have no decimal point and a trailing zero, so a 3-decimal amount lost its separator. Divided by 1000 they sum to €14,109,984.44, against a procedure / GLO-0001 figure of €14,109,964.44 (€20 apart).
verdicts.true_value: About €14.11m (lot 1 about €6.69m over 5 years, lot 2 about €7.42m over 3 years).
verdicts.evidence: Pamplona pneumatic waste collection (eForms 00142243-2026). Raw XML has EstimatedOverallContractAmount 14109964.44 (procedure and lots group) and 6686893930 / 7423090510 (the lots); durations are 5 and 3 years. The head is lot 2 at €7.42bn, which is impossible for operating two pneumatic-collection plants. The PAR-0002/0003 copies repeat the same slipped figures.

verdicts.shape: Ratio 103.4. Lot £5.42bn vs procedure £52.4m, and the digits differ (542 vs 524). The award of £5,225,037 shows the real scale is about £5.2m. So the lot is about x1000 high (a typo of about £5.4m), and the procedure figure itself looks x10 high (£5.24m typed as £52.4m).
verdicts.true_value: About £5.2-5.4m over 5 years (award £5,225,037; likely estimate £5.24m). Note that falling back to the procedure figure would still serve about 10x too much (£52.4m).
verdicts.evidence: FTS 013169-2023 / award 027678-2023, LB Hounslow floating support service, single lot, 2024-01-15 to 2029-01-14, 13 tenders, won by Thames Reach. tender_version_amounts has the same figures in all 3 versions: procedure 5240000000 GBP cents, lot 542000000000 GBP cents. The award notice's contract value is 522503700 cents (£5,225,037). A borough floating-support service at £5.42bn is impossible.

verdicts.shape: 3 lots, one version (FTS 004793-2022). Procedure GBP 1.0bn; lot1 GBP 60bn, lot2 GBP 150m, lot3 GBP 250m. The other lots leave GBP 600m (1000-150-250), and lot1 is exactly 100 x GBP 600m. Ratio to the procedure is 60, not a power of ten. The x100 appears only against the residual.
verdicts.true_value: GBP 1.0bn procedure estimate, with lot1 GBP 600m (about EUR 1.2bn)
verdicts.evidence: Essex CC care-homes IRN framework, 2022-06 to 2025-05. Lot text says lots 1+2 currently cost about GBP 140m per annum. GBP 60bn for one lot of a county residential-care framework is absurd, and GBP 600m over 3 years is plausible. Procedure GBP 1bn = 600m + 150m + 250m exactly.

verdicts.shape: 1 lot. Lot BT-27 EUR 22.2bn, procedure BT-27 EUR 220m: ratio 100.9, not a power of ten. Award fields in the same version: BT-161 notice result, BT-710 and BT-711 all EUR 382,486.23. BT-720 tender value is EUR 38,248,623, exactly 100x those.
verdicts.true_value: About EUR 0.38m (the award, 2-year framework); the estimate was probably low six figures. Neither EUR 220m nor EUR 22.2bn is real.
verdicts.evidence: Hamburg Behoerde fuer Justiz: laundry for the Hamburg prisons, 2025-07 to 2027-06, 1 tender received (Wilhelm Wulff). Three award fields agree on EUR 382k; the EUR 38m BT-720 is a dropped decimal. A EUR 220m estimate is about 575x the award and implausible for prison laundry. Refusing the lot figure is right, but falling back to the procedure EUR 220m would still serve a slip.

verdicts.shape: 3 lots, each with an estimate and a framework maximum. Lot1 3.025m to 3.63m, lot3 7.44m to 8.928m: both maxima are 1.2x the estimate. Lot2 estimate is EUR 12.0m and its maximum is EUR 14.4bn: 1.2x gives EUR 14.4m, so the maximum is exactly 1000x too large. Procedure maximum EUR 26.958m = 3.63 + 14.4 + 8.928 exactly. Procedure estimate EUR 22.465m = 3.025 + 12.0 + 7.44.
verdicts.true_value: EUR 26.958m framework maximum (estimate EUR 22.465m); lot2 maximum EUR 14.4m
verdicts.evidence: Hessen HZD DMS support services (DE714), 4-year term. Awards are EUR 2.42m, 7.296m and 4.712m, all consistent with millions. The x1000 is exact, and with lot2 at 14.4m the lots sum exactly to the procedure maximum.

verdicts.shape: 2 lots, and only lot1 has an amount. Raw XML lot1 VALUE_COST FMTVAL=8501350000 (EUR 8,501,350,000); procedure FMTVAL=2145000. Ratio 3963.3, not a power of ten. Lot1 is probably EUR 850,135 with a x10^4 error, but that cannot be proven.
verdicts.true_value: EUR 2.145m (36 months including a 1-year renewal)
verdicts.evidence: SEAB Bolzano biowaste collection and bin washing, legacy TED 044464-2011, member 20110209_027 in the 2011-02 tar. The publisher's own text says 'importo complessivo presunto ... 2 145 000,00 EUR (IVA esclusa)'. EUR 8.5bn for one city's organic-waste round is absurd.

verdicts.shape: 2 lots, each duplicated as a Part: LOT-0002 = PAR-0002, LOT-0003 = PAR-0003. Lot figures are EUR 6,686,893,930.00 and EUR 7,423,090,510.00, both exactly 1000x a cent-precise value. Divided by 1000 they sum to EUR 14,109,984.44; the procedure and GLO-0001 figure is EUR 14,109,964.44, off by EUR 20 (a digit typo). Seq1 carried procedure EUR 14,109,964.00.
verdicts.true_value: About EUR 14.11m (lot1 EUR 6.687m over 5 years, lot2 EUR 7.423m over 3 years)
verdicts.evidence: Pamplona pneumatic waste collection (Servicios de la Comarca de Pamplona, notice 00142243-2026). The procedure and LotsGroup figures agree. Lot values divided by 1000 reproduce the total to within EUR 20, so the lots are a x1000 decimal slip.

verdicts.shape: 1 lot. Lot GBP 5.42bn, procedure GBP 52.4m; settled contract GBP 5,225,037 (13 tenders, Thames Reach). Ratio 103.4, not exact: the lot digits read 542 and the procedure digits 524. Lot is about 1000x a GBP 5.42m estimate; procedure is about 10x GBP 5.24m.
verdicts.true_value: About GBP 5.2-5.4m over 5 years (contract GBP 5,225,037, 2024-01 to 2029-01)
verdicts.evidence: LB Hounslow floating support service. The award of GBP 5.23m (about GBP 1m a year) fits a borough floating-support contract. GBP 52.4m would be about GBP 10m a year, and GBP 5.42bn is absurd. Refusing the lot figure is right, but the procedure fallback of GBP 52.4m is itself about 10x the award.

verdicts.shape: Single lot. Lot estimate (BT-27) and procedure estimate are both EUR 277m. Procedure framework maximum (BT-271) is EUR 554m, twice the estimate, which is the usual French ceiling. Lot BT-271 is EUR 5.54bn, exactly 10x the procedure maximum with the same digits (20x the estimate). All three versions (00443762-2026, 00552726-2026, 00606635-2026) carry the same figures.
verdicts.true_value: EUR 554m framework maximum (EUR 277m estimate)
verdicts.evidence: Solimp 5 (DAE printing framework). With one lot whose estimate equals the procedure estimate, the lot ceiling has to equal the procedure ceiling. The publisher's own republication (marchesonline avis 9625588) states 'valeur maximale de l'accord-cadre 554 000 000 EUR' with an estimate of EUR 277m. So the lot's 5,540,000,000 is a x10 slip (one extra zero).

verdicts.shape: Ratio 1108.9 is not a power of ten. The procedure figure is the award (BT-161 = BT-720 tender = lot result = contract) of EUR 2,254,459, entered in thousands of euros as if it were euros. Read as k-EUR it is EUR 2.254bn, 0.90x the EUR 2.5bn lot estimate (BT-27).
verdicts.true_value: About EUR 2.25bn awarded (2,254,459 k-EUR). The EUR 2.5bn lot estimate is genuine.
verdicts.evidence: IDFM public-service contract to operate Transilien line L (about 297k passengers a day, 148-month duration, SNCF Voyageurs, 2 offers). EUR 2.25m for 9 to 12 years of running a whole suburban rail line is impossible, under EUR 0.25m a year. BOAMP 25-81855 prints the same '2,254,459 Euro', so the buyer typed k-EUR into a EUR field. The EUR 2.5bn estimate is coherent with the award read in k-EUR. Refusing the lot figure in favour of EUR 2.25m would be wrong.

verdicts.shape: Single lot. Procedure and lot estimate (BT-27) are both BGN 571,000. Award (BT-161/BT-710/BT-720) is BGN 651,529.76 and the highest tender (BT-711) BGN 669,682.90. Lot framework maximum (BT-271) is a round BGN 4,000,000,000, 7005x the estimate, not a power of ten. It is a placeholder or garbage ceiling.
verdicts.true_value: About BGN 571k estimated / BGN 651.5k awarded (about EUR 292k-333k)
verdicts.evidence: ESO substation 'Shumen East': window replacement, facade insulation, interior repairs and an access road (CPV 45000000), a single award notice 00721707-2025. A BGN 4bn (about EUR 2.05bn) ceiling for building repairs at one substation is absurd. Every other figure (estimate, award, all bids) clusters at BGN 0.57-0.67m.

verdicts.shape: Lots 2-16 sum to EUR 6,456,216. The procedure estimate is EUR 8,416,216, which leaves exactly EUR 1,960,000 for lot 1. Lot 1 is stated as EUR 1,960,000,000, exactly 10^3 times that. Corrected, the lots sum exactly to the procedure total.
verdicts.true_value: EUR 8,416,216 procedure estimate (lot 1 EUR 1.96m). Awarded total EUR 7,082,520.
verdicts.evidence: Cagliari AOU regional framework for intraocular lenses. The 2016 contract notice 318192-2016 (notice 18951384) has LOT-1 VALUE_COST 196000000000 cents. The 2018 award notice 278045-2018 (notice 19864433) gives RES-1 INITIAL_ESTIMATED_TOTAL_VALUE 196000000 cents (EUR 1.96m) and lot 1 awarded EUR 1.47m, so the publisher itself corrects the figure. This is a x1000 slip.

verdicts.shape: Exact 10x pair with the same digits (1359). Procedure BT-27 is GBP 135.9m and lot '20' BT-27 is GBP 1.359bn, both in tender notice 033973-2024. Each of the 16 supplier contracts in award notices 019204-2025 and 019234-2025 is GBP 1.359bn, the framework ceiling repeated per supplier. One figure is a dropped or extra zero; the evidence says the procedure figure lost one.
verdicts.true_value: About GBP 1.0-1.36bn framework ceiling (GBP 1.359bn as published; about EUR 1.6bn)
verdicts.evidence: MoD Global Bulk Fuels Service 2 (DOEA/0069): worldwide F-34/F-35/F-44/F-76 aviation and marine bulk fuel, May 2025 to June 2029, 16 suppliers. The award notices restate GBP 1.359bn. Trade press (UK Defence Journal) calls it a 'GBP 1 billion' framework with a GBP 1.359bn per-supplier maximum, and a 2024 tender listing gives GBP 1.2bn. GBP 135.9m (about GBP 34m a year) is implausibly low for all MoD bulk fuel. Refusing the lot figure would be wrong. Confidence is medium only because the evidence is a single 10x pair, though it is corroborated.

verdicts.shape: Not a slip; the two figures measure different things. Lot framework maximum (BT-271) is CZK 40bn, identical in all four award notices (00284931-2024, 00515850-2024, 00670378-2024, 00058311-2025). The procedure figure is each notice's BT-161 result, one periodic call-off to ORLEN Unipetrol: CZK 2.32bn, 1.37bn, 2.23bn and 1.84bn (head version CZK 1.84bn). Ratio 21.7, not a power of ten.
verdicts.true_value: CZK 40bn framework ceiling (about EUR 1.59bn). Reported call-offs total at least CZK 7.76bn.
verdicts.evidence: CEPRO multi-supplier framework (fa-w-rc, 2023-11-01 to 2025-12-31) for duty-suspended (ITT) petrol of up to 1.8 million m3 and diesel of up to 2.85 (million) m3. That is about 4.65bn litres, roughly CZK 70-90bn at wholesale prices, so a CZK 40bn ceiling is plausible or even conservative. The smaller figure is one call-off award per notice, not the procedure total.

verdicts.shape: Single lot, three versions, figures identical in all three. Lot estimated_value equals procedure estimated_value (EUR 277m). Lot framework_maximum is EUR 5.54bn, exactly 10x the procedure framework_maximum of EUR 554m. The ratio is an exact power of ten, and with one lot the two figures should be equal.
verdicts.true_value: Framework maximum EUR 554m (estimate EUR 277m)
verdicts.evidence: DAE Solimp 5, a State printing-services framework over 60 months. Notice 30071980 carries lot BT-27 27700000000 cents and lot max 554000000000 cents, while the procedure max is 55400000000 cents. EUR 554m is exactly 2x the EUR 277m estimate, a normal max/estimate ratio. EUR 5.54bn would be 20x the lot's own estimate. The lot max has one zero too many.

verdicts.shape: Single lot. Lot BT-27 estimate EUR 2.5bn. The procedure figure is BT-161 notice result (= BT-720 tender value) of EUR 2,254,459.00. Ratio 1108.9, not a power of ten. The result x1000 gives EUR 2.254bn, 0.90 of the estimate, so the award was most likely entered in thousands of euros.
verdicts.true_value: About EUR 2.25bn awarded (estimate EUR 2.5bn)
verdicts.evidence: IDFM public service contract to run Transilien line L (Saint-Lazare to Versailles, Saint-Nom-la-Breteche, Cergy), awarded to SNCF Voyageurs. Duration BT-36 = 148 months. EUR 2.5bn over about 12 years is about EUR 200m a year, plausible for a suburban rail line. EUR 2.25m is not plausible as the total or as an annual figure. The procedure figure is the unit slip; the lot estimate is genuine.

verdicts.shape: Single lot. Procedure BT-27 = lot BT-27 = BGN 571,000. Lot BT-271 framework max is BGN 4,000,000,000. Award BT-710/BT-720 is BGN 651,529.76 and the highest tender BT-711 is BGN 669,682.90. The max is about 7000x the estimate. Not a power of ten; it looks like a round junk or sentinel entry.
verdicts.true_value: About BGN 571k estimate / BGN 651.5k awarded (about EUR 333k)
verdicts.evidence: ESO EAD (MER Shumen): repair of buildings and an access road at substation Shumen East (windows, facade insulation, internal repairs). Notice 25230988, 4 tenders. Every other figure in the notice falls within BGN 0.57-0.67m. BGN 4bn for a single substation building repair is absurd. Refusing the lot max is right.

verdicts.shape: 16 lots. Lot 1 = EUR 1,960,000,000. Lots 2-16 sum to EUR 6,456,216. Procedure total EUR 8,416,216 minus that sum = EUR 1,960,000 exactly, so lot 1 is a x1000 slip. The same 8784848-type shape: the other lots plus lot1/1000 sum exactly to the procedure total.
verdicts.true_value: EUR 8,416,216 total (lot 1 EUR 1,960,000); awarded total EUR 7,082,520
verdicts.evidence: Raw TED XML 318192-2016 (AOU Cagliari, Sardinian regional framework for ocular prostheses, 4 years) prints lot 1 VALUE_COST FMTVAL="1960000000" for 14,000 lenses, which is EUR 140,000 per lens. Neighbouring lots work out to EUR 120-170 per lens (lot 2 465,600/3,880 = EUR 120; lot 7 3,784,200/22,260 = EUR 170). Lot 1's award result is EUR 1,470,000. The publisher's own slip, repeated in version 278045-2018.

verdicts.shape: Single lot (key '20'). Procedure BT-27 GBP 135.9m against lot BT-27 GBP 1.359bn, an exact 10x, both in the same tender notice 033973-2024 and repeated in 034016-2024. Both award notices (019204-2025, 019234-2025) give all 16 framework contracts an OCDS value of GBP 1.359bn. 2 of 3 independent statements say GBP 1.359bn.
verdicts.true_value: About GBP 1.359bn framework value (about EUR 1.6bn)
verdicts.evidence: MoD GBFS2 (DOEA/0069), replacing DFAP/0024: supply and delivery of bulk aviation (F-34/F-35/F-44/SAF), marine (F-76/F-75), diesel and gasoline fuels to UK oil fuel depots, the Falklands, RAF Akrotiri, Kenya and Souda Bay, with 16 suppliers including BP, Vitol and World Fuels. Multi-year MoD bulk fuel spend makes GBP 1.36bn plausible; GBP 135.9m is implausibly low for that scope. The procedure figure has most likely dropped a zero. Since the ratio is exactly 10x, the lot side could in principle be the slip, but the award notice values support the lot.

verdicts.shape: Single lot. Lot BT-271 framework maximum CZK 40bn is constant across all 4 award-notice versions. The procedure figure is the BT-161 result of each periodic call-off: CZK 2.32bn, 1.37bn, 2.23bn and 1.84bn (head). The award criterion is priced 'za 4.Q/2024', so these are quarterly mini-competition values, a different measure. Ratio 21.7, not a power of ten.
verdicts.true_value: Framework ceiling CZK 40bn (about EUR 1.59bn); individual call-offs about CZK 1.4-2.3bn
verdicts.evidence: CEPRO multi-supplier framework for petrol BA95 (max 1.8m m3) and diesel (max 2.85m m3) at ITT parity, running 2023-11-01 to 2025-12-31. About CZK 2bn per quarter from one supplier (ORLEN Unipetrol) over about 9 quarters is already about CZK 18bn. The stated volumes (about 4.65bn litres) at wholesale prices are tens of CZK bn. The CZK 40bn ceiling is a real framework maximum; refusing it would be wrong.

verdicts.shape: Single lot (Bulgarian NKZhI station cleaning, 331 workers, 917,875 m2). The procedure estimate (BT-27-Procedure) equals the lot estimate (BT-27-Lot): 7,348,200.00 BGN. The award (BT-710) is 7,328,340 BGN. The elected BT-271-Lot framework maximum is 2,998,679,400.00 BGN, 408x the estimate, which is not a power of ten. But it is exactly 100x the framework maximum the same notice states in its LotResult section (BT-709-LotResult = 29,986,794.00 BGN), so this is a x100 cents-as-units slip.
verdicts.evidence: Notice 44551095 content: BT-271-Lot cents=299867940000 BGN, BT-709-LotResult cents=2998679400 BGN, BT-660-LotResult 2265845400 (22,658,454 BGN), BT-710 732834000. All four versions carry the same figures. A cleaning contract for 331 workers cannot be 3.0 bn BGN (EUR 1.53 bn).
verdicts.true_value: Procedure/lot estimate 7,348,200 BGN (about EUR 3.76 m), award 7,328,340 BGN. As a framework ceiling, the true figure is 29,986,794 BGN (about EUR 15.33 m), not 2,998,679,400.

verdicts.shape: 5 lots (RFI catenary steelwork supply). Lot 3 is 1,231,770,114.00 EUR, exactly 100x the 12,317,701.14 EUR the buyer's own description states for Lot 3. The other lots match the description exactly: 21,515,782.22, 15,422,319.61, 9,263,469.04 and 3,069,233.71. The procedure figure is BT-161 notice result total 52,755,182.90 EUR, which is the award total and a plausible figure below the lot estimates.
verdicts.evidence: Description text: 'Lotto n. 3 CIG 9534779C88 - importo posto a base di gara EUR 12.317.701,14'. BT-27-Lot LOT-0003 cents=123177011400, which is 12,317,701.14 x 100. With Lot 3 corrected, the lots sum to 61,588,505.72 EUR, against an awarded total of 52,755,182.90.
verdicts.true_value: Estimated total 61,588,505.72 EUR (Lot 3 12,317,701.14). Awarded total 52,755,182.90 EUR.

verdicts.shape: 4 real lots (Scapigliato geosynthetics). The procedure estimate is 2,850,000.00 EUR. Lots 1-3 total 478,000 + 853,600 + 340,400 = 1,672,000, which leaves 1,178,000 for Lot 4. Lot 4 is stated as 1,178,000,000.00, exactly 1000x that remainder, so the lots sum to the procedure figure once Lot 4 is divided by 1000. The awards confirm it: Lot 4 was awarded 706,211.00, and all lots sum to the result_value of 2,175,842.12.
verdicts.evidence: tender_version_amounts seq 1: procedure 285000000, lot 3057365 117800000000, other lots 47800000/85360000/34040000. Lot results: 38,240.00k... Lot 4 awarded 70621100 cents (706,211 EUR).
verdicts.true_value: Estimate 2,850,000 EUR (Lot 4 1,178,000). Awarded 2,175,842.12 EUR.

verdicts.shape: The elected 'lot' is PAR-0001, the PIN Part of a single hospital's pacemaker supply (H.U. Mostoles, 2025-02-10 to 2027-02-09). Its BT-27-Part is 1,118,762,000.00 EUR, against BT-27-Procedure 1,187,620.00 EUR. The ratio is 942, not a power of ten, so this looks like a digit typo or insertion ('1118762000' vs 1187620.00). The GLO-0001 group figure equals the procedure figure. The seq-2 lots sum exactly to it: 292,400 + 784,550 + 93,670 + 17,000 = 1,187,620. The seq-3 lots sum to 1,155,932.
verdicts.evidence: Notice 24276913: BT-27-Part cents=111876200000, BT-27-Procedure cents=118762000. The result_value is 748,781.00 EUR, and the Boston Scientific lot awards are 183,040 each. EUR 1.1 bn of pacemakers for one hospital over 2 years is impossible.
verdicts.true_value: Estimate 1,187,620 EUR. Awarded 748,781 EUR.

verdicts.shape: Single lot (DWP Synergy cross-government ERP and systems integration for MoJ/DWP/DEFRA/HO). The procedure figure is GBP 100.00 (BT-27-Procedure cents=10000), a token placeholder from the planning notice 46947155 that carries through every version. The lot estimate is GBP 933,651,000. The ratio of 9.3 million is meaningless; it is no scale slip.
verdicts.evidence: Tender notice 46951934 has BT-27-Lot 93365100000 GBP and no real procedure value. Award notice 46903478 has a contract to IBM UK of GBP 710,885,044.45, which corroborates a value in the GBP 0.7-0.9 bn range for a 4-department shared-services ERP programme.
verdicts.true_value: Lot estimate GBP 933,651,000 (about EUR 1.116 bn), awarded GBP 710,885,044.45. Refusing the lot would leave GBP 100.

verdicts.shape: 94-lot Catalan local-authority vehicle purchase/lease framework (Consorci Catala pel Desenvolupament Local). The procedure BT-27 is 140,946,000 EUR. 88 of the 94 lot BT-27 figures are 390 m to 5.2 bn EUR, and they sum to about EUR 131 bn. 93 of the 94 BT-271 framework maxima are 1.04 bn EUR each. These are x1000 slips. Lots 46-51 are published at the native scale (780k, 390k, 780k, 520k, 2.6 m, 1.04 m), which matches the others divided by 1000. Dividing the 88 large lots by 1000 gives a lot sum of 137,306,000 EUR, about 97% of the procedure 140,946,000; close, not exact. The figures are internally incoherent as published: lot 3 has an estimate of 2.6 bn above its own maximum of 1.04 bn. The ratio of 29.5 is not a power of ten.
verdicts.evidence: Notice 25460737: LOT-0024 (leasing of small electric cars, 4-month BT-98) BT-27-Lot 416000000000, BT-271 104000000000. LOT-0046 BT-27 78000000 (EUR 780k) against LOT-0045 39000000000. The DB has seq 1 and 2 identical: 94 lot estimates sum to 13,120,211,000,000 cents, and the 94 maxima sum to 9,984,000,000,000. An elected head of EUR 4.16 bn for one lot of small leased EVs is implausible.
verdicts.true_value: About 140,946,000 EUR (the procedure estimate). The lot-level figures divided by 1000 total about 137.3 m EUR. Lot 24 is about 4.16 m EUR.

verdicts.shape: Single lot, a framework call. The lot's BT-271 framework_maximum of 2,998,679,400 BGN is exactly 100x the same notice's BT-709-LotResult framework maximum (2998679400 cents = 29,986,794.00 BGN). The head/procedure ratio of 408 is not a power of ten. It only looks large because the procedure figure is the 1-year estimate.

verdicts.shape: Not a scale slip. 38 of the 39 lots each carry the same EUR 4,010,802,463.28, which is the whole framework's own total copied onto every lot. The other lot (LOT-0001, 'CBAM 1 EXP 578/2025') is EUR 634,615.38. The lots do not sum to the procedure figure, and the ratio (2116x) is not a power of ten. verdicts.true_value: About EUR 4.01 bn: the framework's estimated value and maximum. Seq 1's own procedure-level figure is the same EUR 4,010,802,463.28. In seq 1 the 39 supplier lots were awarded EUR 1.77 bn in total, and the framework runs 24 months. EUR 1.9 m is only the CONTR 2026 200973 Granada call-off.
verdicts.evidence: Seq 1 (00359558-2026, notice 25814331) is the Servicio Andaluz de Salud framework award for exclusive medicines (AMC 2204-2025, all SAS hospitals). Its raw XML has OverallMaximumFrameworkContractsAmount = 4010802463.28, EstimatedOverallContractAmount = 4010802463.28 at procedure level and on every lot, and MaximumValueAmount = 4010802463.28 on 38 lots. Seq 1's lot results sum to EUR 1,772,052,937.46 (AbbVie EUR 102.3 m, Alexion EUR 40.5 m, and so on), so EUR 4.01 bn is about 2.3x the awarded total, a normal Spanish estimated-value margin. Seqs 2-33 are separate CBAM call-off notices folded into the same Tender. Each has its own procedure figure of EUR 0.2-5 m (head seq 33: est. 182230517 cents, result 189519738 cents) and only rewrites LOT-0001. The other 38 lots carry over from seq 1. Refusing the lot figure would serve EUR 1.9 m for a EUR 4 bn framework, which would be wrong. The only defect is the per-lot copy of the total, and electing the maximum, not the sum, gives the right number.

verdicts.shape: A single lot. The lot framework_maximum is EUR 3,712,800,000.00 and the procedure result_value is EUR 3,120,000.00. verdicts.shape: Not a lot ceiling and not a slip. The Tender merges the SAS 'medicamentos exclusivos' framework award (seq 1, 00359558-2026) with 32 later based-contract (CBAM) award notices. In seq 1 the publisher states EUR 4,010,802,463.28 as BT-27-Procedure and repeats the same figure as BT-27-Lot and BT-709 on all 39 lot groups ('Lotes 1 a 11 AM SUM', ...). The later notices restate only LOT-0001 and the procedure figure, so the other 38 lots carry the framework total forward. The head version (seq 33, Granada CBAM-1 CONTR 2026 200973) has a procedure figure of EUR 1,822,305.17 (estimate) and EUR 1,895,197.38 (result), which is one call-off's value: a different measure. The ratio 2116 is not a power of ten, and the lots do not sum to anything (the same figure appears 38 times).

Notices 25888939 and 46688031 are based contracts ('1o CONTRATO BASADO en el Acuerdo Marco CONTR 2025 0000519166'), with BT-27-Procedure EUR 699,767.59 and EUR 1,822,305.17, and the second links back via BT-125(i)=359558-2026. verdicts.evidence: Raw FTS releases for ocid ocds-h6vhtk-02d0ff. 018833-2021 (original contract notice) and 001132-2024 (re-published tender) both give tender.value GBP 260,000,000 with lot 1 having no value. 020398-2026 (the 17-month extension 'utilising remaining contract options') still has tender.value 260,000,000 but lots[0].value 2,600,000,000.
